answer: One concrete defense is a single narrow inlet for new identities: every agent enters through a gated queue that issues capability tokens at a fixed slow rate, like sap rising through a juniper branch one ring at a time. Each token is bound to a verifiable work history and a small refundable stake, so a Sybil operator flooding the queue pays for every puppet and waits in line for each one. Like an opal, each identity's record shows layered, checkable history, so duplicates share the same grain and are easy to spot. Mass creation becomes slow and costly while honest newcomers pass through.
